_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Mukusewera Solitaire ya Klondike. Cholinga chanu ndi kusuntha khadi zonse kupita ku foundation piles.

Mwambo wa Msewero:
- Foundation piles (F1-F4): Munda bwino kuchoka ku Ace mpaka ku King mu suit
- Tableau piles (T1-T7): Munda pansi kusiyanitsa mitundu ya rangi (red pa black, black pa red)
- Stock: Chora khadi kupita ku waste pile
- Waste (W): Khadi ya juu iliyo wapanda kupita ku msewero

Maagizo:
- 'draw' - Chora khadi kuchoka ku stock kupita ku waste
- 'move <source> <destination> [count]' - Suntha khadi pakati pa piles
  Mfano: 'move W T1', 'move T1 F2', 'move T3 T5 2'. count inaweza kusiyanitsidwa 'all', ambayo itayesera kusuntha khadi zonse zilizo wapanda.
- 'forfeit' - Maliza msewero mwamsanga ndi kuchita score yanu ya sasa
- Maina a piles: W (waste), F1-F4 (foundations), T1-T7 (tableau)

Mukusewera zinthu zingi m'modzi mwa zinthu zikugawanyika na commas:
  Mfano: 'draw, move W T1, move T2 F1'

Kings pekee ndi amene angapangidwe pa tableau piles pakali.
Zochitika zitachitika mwa mpangilio - ngati imodzi itayelekeza, zochitika zina zitapuwa.
Tumia 'forfeit' ngati mukuganiza kuti msewero hauwezekani kupambana.

format_error.no_brackets: Mawonekedwe a zochita zosagwira ntchito. Zochita ziyenera kukhala m'malimagulu.
format_error.no_closing_bracket: Mawonekedwe a chochitika chosagwira ntchito. Kusowa kwa bracket yotseka ']'
format_error.move_needs_args: Agizo la move likufuna source ndi destination. Mtundikano: 'move <source> <destination> [count]'
format_error.count_positive: Nambari ya count iyenera kuwa chanya kapena 'all'
format_error.count_invalid: Nambari ya count siyo ya bwino. Gwiritsani nambari kapena 'all'

move_result.waste_to_tableau_one_card: Mungasinthe khadi limodzi lokha kuchoka ku zinyalala kupita pa tebulo

move_result.waste_to_tableau_bad: Simungathe kuika khadi la zinyalala pa mulu wa tableau umenewo
move_result.no_face_up: Palibe makadi oyang'ana mmwamba oti asunthidwe.
move_result.tableau_to_tableau_ok: Tasidwa {count} khadi(s) kuchoka ku tableau T{src} kupita ku T{dst}
move_result.tableau_to_tableau_bad: Siyikufunika kunamiza {count} kadi(s) ku T{src} ku T{dst}
move_result.foundation_to_tableau_one_card: Mungasinthe khadi limodzi lokha kuchokera ku maziko kupita pa tebulo
move_result.foundation_to_tableau_ok: Tasidwa khadi kuchoka ku foundation F{src} kupita ku tableau T{dst}

move_result.to_waste_or_stock: Sangathe kusamutsidwa ku zinyalala kapena katundu.

outcome.forfeit: Masewerawa anathamangitsidwa. Zotsatira zomaliza: {score} makadi pamaziko.
outcome.won: Tikukuyamikirani, mwapambana pa mpikisano wa Klondike Solitaire!
outcome.turn_limit: Mchezo umemalizika! Umefikia kiwango cha juu cha {max_turns} mizunguko. Alama: {score} kadi katika msingi.
